data.body: Root cause confirmed: the fixture's foreign-key events are sound signatures by a key off the author's keyring, which verify-identity has reported as signer-not-on-keyring since 9a6ed375112; 717c50f8b33 asserted the older bad-signature verdict. Product code check: reclaim_resign.build_resign_plan takes every entry in the failing list by event_uuid/ticket_id and never reads the verdict; reclaim_collapse only consumes the plan; reclaim_dry_run's count regex already parses signer-not-on-keyring. No product code filters on verdict names. Fix (commit 2825b4fe283): assert the exact set {unsigned, signer-not-on-keyring}. test_reclaim_resign.py + test_reclaim_dry_run.py: 13 passed locally. make verify running.
